DataLevel.description: How much the farm has told Demenova: 0 pin, 1 outline + zones, 2 lots, 3 field notes.
DataLevel.title: DataLevel

Mode.description: Farmer mode (one status, one alert, one action) or agronomist mode (full detail).
Mode.title: Mode

Origin.description: Where a value comes from (docs/DATA_POLICY.md §1). Every stored or displayed value carries exactly one.
Origin.title: Origin

OriginSpec.description: Origin of the values in the same object: either one origin for all of them, or a map from field name to origin where the key '*' is the default for fields not listed. A sibling '<field>_origin' always wins over this.

Position.description: [longitude, latitude] in EPSG:4326 (optional altitude in m).

StorageMode.description: Offline storage mode (ADR-004): full = status + 90 days + imagery cache; saver = status + 7 days.
StorageMode.title: StorageMode

UnitSystem.description: Display units. Storage is always SI; imperial is a display-only conversion.
UnitSystem.title: UnitSystem

description:
A farm. Same fields in Supabase `farms`, in domain/farm.json and in the demo snapshot.

v1 additions to the draft: `origin` (CONTRACTS.md §2 asks for origin metadata on every numeric field;
it covers location, outline and data_level) and nullable country, province and canton (a farm that is
only a pin has no way to know them).

id.description: farm_<slug>; the slug is lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.

owner_id.description: Supabase auth user id from anonymous sign-in (ADR-003). null for the demo farm and for local-only farms.

outline.description: Farm outline (data level 1 and above), else null.

catchment_id.description: Id of the upstream catchment that drains to the farm.

alert_email.description: Recipient of Severe emails. Personal data: always null on the demo farm, whose recipient is the backend environment variable ALERT_EMAIL_TO.

anyOf.description: Random, unguessable code of a farm for the Telegram link /start <code> (D-017, PENDING.md P-002 b). Generated by the database (default: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters); the pattern mirrors the farms.telegram_code check in supabase/migrations/20261114000200_core_tables.sql.

telegram_code.description: Contract 1.1.0 (D-020). Server-generated, never client-writable: clients omit the key when they write a farm (sending it, even as null, is rejected by the column grants). Present on farm rows read from Supabase by the owner, or by anyone for the demo farm; absent or null on local-only farms and in payloads that did not select it.

is_demo.description: True only for the synthetic demo farm, which the UI labels 'Demo'.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp, ISO 8601, with a 'Z' or '+00:00' offset.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp, ISO 8601, with a 'Z' or '+00:00' offset.

title: Farm
